text:
Maya Chen: micro-standup — quick status (what I did / blockers / today)

Did: wired the colibri-v4 eval harness into the nightly infra, ran an initial sweep across spanish promptset and saw a regression on exact-match.
Blocker: kv-cache shadow experiments failing on long-ctx paths (seen during decode warmup).
Today: triage the EM regression, coordinate a canary hold, open a regression ticket with eval ids. Ping @Alex R for rollout timing.

Alex R: nice summary. I merged infra PR that fixes autoscaling noise (https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/678). I can take the rollout coordination this afternoon (3–5pm PT). No blockers on my side. :thumbsup:

Omar N: blocker here — quantize script crashes on colibri-v4 with OOM when running on a single A100. Error: `RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory` after step 2. Repro command: `python quantize.py --model colibri-v4`. Suspect tensor-parallel sharding in the tool.

Danielle P: quick eval note — nightly batch shows colibri-v4 EM -3.8% on qa-spanish (full diff in dashboard). I started rerunning with prompt normalization to check if tokenization/whitespace is the culprit.

eval-bot: nightly-evals/colibri-v4 (2026-03-18T03:12Z) summary: EM -3.8%, avg_len +2.1 tokens, latency +12ms. Full results: https://console.redwood.ai/evals/colibri-v4/20260318

Maya Chen: thanks @Danielle. @Omar — can you try `--keep-kv-cache` and smaller batch sizes? Please paste a minimal repro snippet so we can triage faster.

Omar N: minimal repro below — running on single A100(40GB):
```python
from inference import load_model
m = load_model('colibri-v4', quantize='int8')
outputs = m.generate('¿Cuál es la capital de España?')
```
Will try batch 2 and `--keep-kv-cache` now.

Alex R: if the quantize tool keeps failing, we can spin a dedicated repro on a small Dedicated pool. I have slots 3–5pm PT and can help repro there.

Danielle P: FYI I added failing prompt IDs 42 and 73 to the eval dashboard and started a manual run with normalized prompts; preliminary result recovered to EM -0.8%. I'll finish the full normalized rerun and share CSV.

Maya Chen: action plan:
1) Omar: try smaller batch + `--keep-kv-cache` and paste logs.
2) Danielle: rerun normalized set and attach final csv + failing prompt examples.
3) Alex: coordinate dedicated repro if needed and hold canary rollout.
4) Maya: open regression ticket linking eval-id + infra PR + quantize logs.
Please react with :eyes: on PRs if you review.

Alex R: added registry tag for canary: `colibri-v4:canary-20260318`. Also opened a staging rollout slot but holding until we confirm normalized run.

Maya Chen: small ask — if anyone reviews infra/serving PR #1234 today please add :eyes: to speed merge and avoid surprise canary drift.

Omar N: update — reduced batch 8 -> 2 and tried `--keep-kv-cache`; quantize completed successfully. Uploading artifact: `s3://redwood-artifacts/colibri-v4/int8/20260318.tar.gz`. Logs show memory peak ~36GB.

Danielle P: nice. kicked off the normalized rerun against the eval set, ETA ~25m.

eval-bot: rerun-start colibri-v4-int8 normalized-set job_id=ev-88123

Maya Chen: great progress. I'll wait for Danielle's final numbers before deciding on canary rollout. Thanks team :raised_hands:
